title: Turkish-Style Kisir Salad with Cheese
description: A refreshing and healthy salad made with kisir, cheese, and a hint of garlicky flavor.

ingredients.name: kisir
ingredients.notes: chopped dried parsley, garlic, and red pepper flakes

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the bulgur, yogurt, cheese, and kisir.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice.
3. Pour the dressing over the bulgur mixture and toss to combine.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
6. Just before serving, sprinkle with parsley and serve chilled.
